sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum parts using sample chopping and beat repeat to create tight, rhythmic West Coast hip-hop drum grooves with emphasis on sparse verse sections and energetic hooks.

bass_generator.brief: Produce basslines that complement rhythmic groove using sparse notes in verses and more driving lines in hooks, aligned with aggressive mood and tonal center.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chordal pads and harmonic textures using chopped sustained samples to support vocal lead and maintain West Coast atmosphere without overpowering.

melody_generator.brief: Add melodic interest with chopped vocal slices and call-response motifs emphasizing hooks; keep verses minimal to highlight vocals.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement focusing on vocal prominence, sparse verses, and strong energetic hooks, ensuring energy profile matches prompt specifications.

presetor.brief: Select and assign appropriate sample chop based presets to channels reflecting desired texture and energy distribution.

songgps.brief: Validate arrangement structure, section energy mapping, and marker placements corresponding to vocal-focused hip-hop with aggressive mood.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix channels prioritizing vocal clarity and energy dynamics, sidechaining drums to vocals and preserving punchy, clean mix for final output.
